text: The Site is at grade +15.00 m a.s.l. on Owner-placed engineered fill (1.5 m to 3.0 m, compacted to 95 % Standard Proctor). The typical profile per ALP-OWN-GEO-001 is: 0 m to 2.5 m engineered fill; 2.5 m to 9 m loose to medium dense silty sand (SPT N 6 to 18), liquefiable under the DD-2 earthquake; 9 m to 18 m soft to firm compressible clay (cu 30 to 70 kPa); 18 m to 25 m dense sand and gravel (SPT N > 40) where present; weathered sandstone / marl (UCS 5 MPa to 25 MPa) below, with the top of rock between about 18 m and 25 m. Depths are below grade.
